name: claude-mods
description: Claude Code mods: Plannotator reviews on the tailnet, pull-request links on the hint line, implementer/judge bead pairs, a human review loop, and more to come

plugins.name: plannotator-tailnet
plugins.description: Publishes this session's live Plannotator reviews on the tailnet, as a link above the prompt

plugins.name: pr-links
plugins.description: Pins the pull/merge request this session's commands print, as a clickable link on the hint line

plugins.name: implement-beads
plugins.description: Runs beads unattended as implementer + judge teammate pairs in herdr panes; implementers can never close their own bead

plugins.name: human-review
plugins.description: Claude teaches you its change (walkthrough + diagrams), then reviews it with you in Plannotator until Approve

plugins.name: vr-quest
plugins.description: Meta Quest VR desktop on Linux: Immersed (virtual/portrait displays, layout, frozen-screen diagnostics) or free WiVRn + WayVR (USB, hand tracking, apps in VR)
